name: io.github.sourabhnk/mosaic-mcp
title: Mosaic Pre-Clinical Intelligence
description: Pre-clinical drug-target intelligence: 60 curated targets, 2,687 counted partner genes, 12 tools

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL/Neon connection string for YOUR Mosaic knowledge graph (must end /mosaic_db). Bring your own database — no shared instance is provided.

environmentVariables.name: MOSAIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key unlocking the 7 Pro tools (optional; the 5 free tools work without it)

environmentVariables.name: MOSAIC_TIER
environmentVariables.description: Override tier for local dev: free (default), pro, or enterprise
